test_title: PYST 6: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. X is sitting third to the left of U. V is sitting second to the left of X. U is the only one sitting between T and V. S is sitting third to the left of V. Who is sitting between S and W?
solution:
**Given: **Six friends S, T, U, V, W and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

X is sitting third to the left of U. V is sitting second to the left of X.

U is the only one sitting between T and V. S is sitting third to the left of V. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1569124ddcf73c4793d15015e3d7a00ec612a19552780d3980e94075d8de58c9.png] 

Thus, X is sitting between S and W.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
